acceptanceCriteria: A Git probe that expires on its own bound during a dogfood event reports a time-bound code, not dogfood-event-unavailable.
LCP-V0-008's code list and its test cover that path, or the spec records why unavailable is correct.
body: internal/gokernel/repository.go:24 fixes gitDeadline at 10 seconds; on expiry the probe returns repository-probe-timeout (repository.go:161). cmd/corvint/local_completion_event.go:147 maps an error to dogfood-event-deadline only when the event context itself expired, so a probe that times out on its own bound reaches the generic branch at :156 and reports dogfood-event-unavailable. In production the 1600 ms event deadline always fires first, so the gap is reachable when a caller supplies a longer event deadline through dogfoodEventDeadlineKey, which the cmd/corvint tests do (local_completion_claude_test.go:132 uses 10 minutes). On a loaded host TestDogfoodEventReadOnlyEnrolledStopAndPrompt then fails with dogfood-event-unavailable, which reads as a product fault instead of a time bound (seen 2026-09-27 at load 200 to 290 on origin/main 3cd473ba plus V1-0295). Fix options: map gokernel repository-probe-timeout to dogfood-event-deadline, and/or let the tests' longer event deadline also lengthen the Git probe bound.
title: Git probe timeout inside a dogfood event reports dogfood-event-unavailable, not a time-bound code
